rows.reason: Does not teach the method: "The opposite of hot is cold." only announces the key; it never says what hot means and flips it (as rows 03-25 do), so the step that finds the answer is missing. Distractor lines are true; question sound (no option is an opposite of another sense of hot, e.g. spicy/mild, angry/calm).

Does not teach the method: "The opposite of high is low." only announces the key with no meaning flipped. Also "Tall, steep and towering all describe something high" is not true of steep, which describes a slope, not height. Question sound.
Early as before the expected time, late as after it; soon, initial and first sit close to early. True; no option opposes another sense of early.
Empty as nothing inside, full as no room left; hollow and blank close to empty; heavy is about weight. True; question sound.
Light bag/heavy bag shows the weight sense; bright and pale correctly named as other senses of light; soft fits light (a light touch). No option is dark, so no opposite of another sense. True.
Buy as paying, sell as being paid; spend and purchase go with buying; give involves no payment. True; question sound.
Above as higher than, below as lower than; over and upstairs close to above; beside as next to. True.
Push as away from you, pull as towards you; shove, press and nudge are kinds of push. True; question sound.
Appear as come into sight, vanish as go out of sight; arrive and emerge close; seem correctly named as another sense of appear. No option opposes the seem sense. True.
Noisy as lots of sound, silent as no sound; loud, rowdy and deafening near-synonyms. True; question sound.
Smooth as no bumps, rough as bumpy; flat, silky and even close to smooth. True; no option opposes another sense.
Brave faces danger, timid shies away; bold and daring near-synonyms; lazy is about work, not fear. True.
Wide as long way side to side, narrow as short way across; broad and baggy close; short correctly placed as the opposite of long. True; question sound.
Deep water goes far down, shallow does not; bottomless close, dark goes with deep (deep colours); wide is side to side. True.
Begin as start, finish as bring to an end; start and open close to begin; wait as holding off. True; question sound.
Remember as keeping in mind, forget as losing from mind; recall and recollect synonyms; misplace is losing a thing. True.
Sharp knife cuts well, blunt does not; pointed, spiky and keen close to sharp. No option opposes another sense (dull, mild, gradual absent). True.
Tame as used to people, wild as living free; gentle and trained close; dull correctly named as another sense of tame (a tame party). No option opposes that sense. True.
Victory as winning, defeat as losing; triumph and win synonyms; a draw is neither. True; question sound.
Ancient as very long ago, modern as present day; old and antique close; shiny is about looks. True.
Arrive as get to a place, depart as leave it; reach and come close; travel is the journey between. True.
Expand as get bigger, shrink as get smaller; stretch and grow close; bend changes shape, not size. True.
Rise as go up, fall as come down; climb, soar and lift all mean going up. True; question sound.
Joy as great happiness, sorrow as great sadness; delight and happiness synonyms; anger a different feeling. True.
Accept as saying yes, refuse as saying no; receive, take and agree close to accept. Refuse covers both senses of accept. True.
